categories.name: Administrative or Political Part-Whole
categories.definition: One entity is a geographical or political subdivision, component, or administrative part of the other.

categories.name: Geographical Location
categories.definition: One entity is physically located, situated, or found within the geographical boundaries of the other.

categories.name: Organizational Affiliation
categories.definition: An entity belongs to, is employed by, is a member of, or is affiliated with an organization, group, or team.

categories.name: Creative Authorship
categories.definition: One entity is the creator, author, writer, composer, or originator of a creative work, product, or invention.

categories.name: Performance or Representation
categories.definition: An entity performs, acts in, represents, or is the featured subject of a work, event, or role.

categories.name: Ownership
categories.definition: One entity owns, possesses, or holds the property rights to the other.

categories.name: Product or Brand Origin
categories.definition: A product, brand, or model is produced, manufactured, developed, or published by a parent entity.

categories.name: Family Relationship
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other by blood, marriage, or lineage.

categories.name: Hydrological Feature
categories.definition: One water body flows into, is a tributary of, or is part of the river system of another.

categories.name: Event-Entity Association
categories.definition: An entity participates in, hosts, wins, or is the subject of a specific event, competition, or award.

categories.name: Taxonomic Classification
categories.definition: One entity is a biological taxon (e.g., family, order) or classifies the other within a scientific hierarchy.

categories.name: Derivation or Equivalence
categories.definition: One entity is derived from, inspired by, based on, translates, or is an equivalent form of the other.

categories.name: Named After
categories.definition: One entity is named after or bears the name of the other entity.

categories.name: Topographical or Physical Part
categories.definition: One entity is a physical part, component, or topographical feature of a larger geographical or physical entity.
